environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. environment.widescreen: GT4_FORCE_WIDESCREEN unset or 1 holds 16:9 at guest VBlank; 0 leaves the game setting
environment.display_aspect: GT4_DISPLAY_ASPECT unset or auto follows the game window client area (16:9 headless); 16:9, 4:3, W:H or a decimal 0.5..8 fix it; any other value refuses the start. GT4_ASPECT_FOV_EXTRA 0.5..3.0, default 1.0. At 16:9 with 1.0 nothing is written and frames are byte-identical.

limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Interlaced races (480i held) and the 1080i/PAL modes are not checked; only the 480i menus capture (slice191 stream) was replayed headless.
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
The owner night-race numbers (59.97 FPS, 53 late frames) were measured on slice198 with gt4-gs 0.3.2; slice199 on gt4-gs 0.4.0 needs the owner's night race and F8 A/B (GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC 1 vs 0).
GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC is proven equivalent (identical stream bytes, identical frames) on the recorded headless schedules only; race scenes are checked by the owner F8 A/B.
Crash-safe card: the kill test kills a copy writer (TerminateProcess), not an OS power cut; FlushFileBuffers/_commit is trusted, not measured on a power cut.
Installed-folder run (<exe>\shaders, <exe>\gs) is smoked from private/slice200-dist only; the owner installs nothing.

Release build (slice213): no build-time shader fallback. The build tree runs from its own shaders copy (CMake POST_BUILD from the pinned slice153 capsule); the runtime_dependencies below are the capsule files that copy is made from.

Vulkan baseline path (slice214): headless runs create the instance and device on both paths but never present; the presentation half of the baseline path is checked by CTest native_vulkan_pixels_baseline (hidden Win32 window, repeat, zero size, resize) and the owner.
Headless runs do not reach a save: the menus schedule leaves the card byte-identical to the seed; the exit flush is checked by the build and the fixture, not by a saved headless card.

The cursor auto-hide, the "Compiling shaders" notice and the overlay are checked with a short visible fixture window and hidden-window replays only; the owner checks them in the game (fullscreen and windowed).
GPU usage comes from the Windows "GPU Engine" performance counters (PDH) of the two processes; other GPU vendors and drivers are not checked.

gt4-gs 1.0.1 (Documents\PCSX2 fix): the offline replay (--replay-gscap) with a DataRoot config stops after VM initialization (exit -16843010, same stop as the 1.0.0 logs); the folder check is therefore a startup-only check.

License guard v2: a license demo (either loader) that fails the game CRC and is not the single-Recorder layout gets record count 0xFFFFFFFF (no demo inputs); its demo or background replay does not play. Demos that decrypt sane still have wrong bytes in their header region (FPU not bit-exact; TASK-017 root cause not fixed).

Seed closure changes 325 of 326 generated units (+3,728 dispatch ids). Known-path equivalence is shown only by the headless frame comparison and owner play; the object comparison confirms only that the unchanged units compile identically with clang-cl 23.1.2.
The executable was built with clang-cl 22.1.3 (as slice206), so the library is the only changed variable between slice206 and slice208.
